cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You swiped the birthday photo away, so I did too. Deleted. I'll be honest: I was eating dinner alone when you rang.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That just closes the preview. Your brother's in our kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He came for dessert. By dinner, I mean the main course.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's beside you while you're carving the chicken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carving isn't eating. I meant the moments when food was actually in my mouth.

reason: Copied preview dismissal is mistaken for evidence deletion; B surviving photo progressively forces narrower dinner and eating definitions.
